original_ai_output.title_zh: 加纳NDC成员对Kwabre East选区执行委员会选举提出安全担忧
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 加纳全国民主大会党（NDC）Kwabre East选区部分成员及支持者对该选区定于10月25日（周六）举行的执行委员会选举提出安全担忧，称当前气氛令人怀疑选举能否和平、可信地举行。他们质疑选区选举委员会将投票地点设在Aboaso-Zongo伊斯兰大厅的决定。相关担忧目前仅来自单一来源报道，尚未获得独立证实。

location.raw_text: Kwabre East Constituency, Islamic Hall at Aboaso-Zongo

key_facts.fact: NDC Kwabre East选区成员对10月25日执行委员会选举提出安全担忧
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Some members and sympathisers of the National Democratic Congress (NDC) in the Kwabre East Constituency have raised concerns over alleged security threats ahead of the constituency executive elections scheduled for Saturday, October 25

key_facts.fact: 成员质疑选举委员会将投票地点设在Aboaso-Zongo伊斯兰大厅的决定
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: They have questioned the decision by the Constituency Election Committee to hold the election at the Islamic Hall at Aboaso-Zongo

key_facts.fact: 成员称当前气氛令人怀疑选举能否和平可信举行
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The members say the prevailing atmosphere raises concerns about whether the polls can be conducted peacefully and credibly

uncertainties: 所谓安全威胁为成员指控，尚未证实
选举能否和平可信举行尚不确定
目前仅单一来源报道，缺乏交叉验证
